summary: Field-normalization mapping and timezone alignment for SIEM JSONL export (quarterly compliance bundle)
description:
Issue summary:
FinWave has requested the March compliance bundle exported as line-delimited JSON (JSONL) for ingestion into their SIEM. They reported that event timestamps are arriving with mixed timezones (some events stamped in UTC, others in local zone), and field names do not match their mapping (e.g. 'actor_id' vs 'user.id', 'service' vs 'source_service'). They require a normalized field map, stable event IDs for de-duplication, and a rotation-friendly SFTP key policy included in the delivery manifest.

Impact:
- Customer cannot ingest events reliably into their SIEM due to mismatched field names and timezone drift, causing gaps in audit coverage for the quarter.
- Compliance deadline: quarterly audit ingest completes 2026-03-31.

Environment:
- Hosted Redwood API (prod, us-east)
- Export pipeline: audit-exporter -> S3 (s3://redwood-audit-exports/finwave/2026Q1/) -> scheduled SFTP push to FinWave endpoint

Steps to reproduce / gather evidence requested:
1) Request a JSONL export for tenant finwave-prod with date range 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31 using the console export job.
2) Inspect the delivered file at s3://redwood-audit-exports/finwave/2026Q1/exports-2026-03-12.jsonl and sample the first 100 lines.
3) Check the delivery manifest and the signed key fingerprints in the SFTP handshake logs.

Observed behavior:
- Mixed timestamp formats found: ISO-8601 with timezone offsets and naive timestamps without offset. Example lines attached in 'logs'.
- Field normalization mismatch: customer expects nested user.id and event.source.service but we currently export flat keys in several variants.
- The manifest provided references key id 'rot-2025' but customer rotated keys in Feb 2026; SFTP connection shows accepted key but FinWave's ingest flagged signature mismatch.

Expected behavior:
- JSONL with consistent UTC timestamps (ISO-8601 Z) and a guaranteed 'event_id' UUID per event for de-duplication.
- A standard mapping layer applied at export time to match FinWave's SIEM field schema and an accompanying mapping file in the bundle.
- Delivery manifest containing current key fingerprints and a rotation policy note.

Attachments: export sample, delivery_manifest.json (from S3), SFTP handshake excerpt (redacted), customer mapping template.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) From Console > Audits > Exports, create export for tenant finwave-prod for date range 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-31.
2) Wait for scheduled delivery to s3://redwood-audit-exports/finwave/2026Q1/ and fetch exports-2026-03-12.jsonl.
3) Use jq or a JSONL parser to sample first 100 events and inspect 'timestamp', 'actor*', 'service*' fields.
4) Compare manifest fingerprints against SFTP server logs in /var/log/sftp/ on delivery host (internal).
investigation_notes:
Initial triage by Support on 2026-03-10: confirmed exported file contains mixed timestamp formats and inconsistent keys. Cross-checked exporter codepath in audit-exporter v1.12.3; mapping layer introduced as opt-in (flag 'normalize_fields') in PR #2148 but default was off for legacy customers. Linked PRs indicate mapping changes were merged behind a feature flag.

Hypotheses:
- Export job for finwave-prod was created without normalize_fields=true, resulting in raw fields.
- Timestamp normalization step runs in the manifest post-processing lambda but failed for some events due to null timezone metadata pulled from older logs.
- SFTP key rotation mismatch due to manifest referencing prior key id; deployment of rotation update to exporter service on 2026-02-15 may not have updated the manifest generator template.

Checks performed:
- Verified job config: console shows 'legacy_export' = true for this tenant.
- Searched logs: exporter lambda logs show 34 warnings 'tz-unknown' between 2026-01-01 and 2026-03-12.
- Confirmed PR #2199 adjusted manifest generator, but deployment to prod was rolled back on 2026-02-20 for an unrelated regression.

Next steps recommended:
1) Re-run export with 'normalize_fields=true' and 'force_utc=true' for finwave-prod and verify sample.
2) Regenerate delivery manifest after confirming current SFTP key fingerprints with FinWave.
3) Provide FinWave a short mapping file (CSV/JSON) and a one-time script to remap existing JSONL if they prefer in-place transformation.
4) Schedule a brief joint call with FinWave SRE to validate key fingerprints and sftp handshake behavior.
workaround: On request, Support built a temporary transformation script (Python) to normalize 2026Q1 JSONL into FinWave's schema and uploaded it to s3://redwood-audit-exports/finwave/2026Q1/normalized-exports-2026-03-12.jsonl. Script includes: convert timestamps to UTC (Z), map actor_id->user.id, service->source.service, and inject deterministic event_id (UUID v5 using event payload hash). Delivered to customer as stopgap while production fix is scheduled.
comments: 2026-03-10 - Aisha Patel (Support): Opened ticket after customer report. Attached sample JSONL and manifest. Requested confirmation of current SFTP key fingerprints from FinWave.
2026-03-11 - Ethan Cole (Eng - Exports): Assigned for triage. Noted that normalize_fields was behind feature flag; will check tenant flags and lambda logs. Linked PRs #2148 and #2199 for context.

2026-03-12 - FinWave SRE (customer): Confirmed they rotated keys on 2026-02-03 and provided fingerprint SHA256:xyz...; they saw signature mismatch for one of the deliveries (we provided handshake logs). Asked for an immediate normalized bundle for ingest—deadline 2026-03-14 for internal audit team.

2026-03-12 - Ethan Cole: Produced a normalized sample and uploaded to S3 path and shared with customer. Initiated a rollback of legacy_export flag for finwave-prod. Asked infra to validate SFTP key set on delivery host.

2026-03-13 - Infra (internal): Validated SFTP host accepted current fingerprint SHA256:xyz...; identified manifest generator still referencing rot-2025 due to stale config in template-renderer service. Patch to template-renderer drafted in github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2215.

2026-03-13 - Support (Aisha): Notified customer of progress and shared temporary normalized bundle. Requested confirmation that their SIEM ingests the normalized file successfully; awaiting confirmation.
resolution: Pending - temporary normalized bundle delivered. Engineering to deploy template-renderer patch (PR #2215) and enable normalize_fields for finwave-prod, then re-run export. Final resolution will include updated manifest and documented rotation policy notes for FinWave.
resolution_notes: If PR #2215 is deployed successfully, schedule re-export and confirm with FinWave SRE. Post-deployment tasks: update support runbook with checklist to verify manifest key_id/fingerprint prior to scheduled SFTP pushes and add automatic timezone fallback to exporter lambda.
root_cause: Configuration and deployment drift: normalization feature behind a feature flag and manifest template out-of-sync with key rotation records after a partial rollback in Feb 2026.
follow_up_actions: Deploy PR #2215 to prod and run canary export for finwave-prod
Enable normalize_fields=true and force_utc=true for tenant finwave-prod
Add a pre-delivery manifest validation job that cross-checks key fingerprints with customer-supplied values
Document SFTP key rotation checklist in Support runbook and send quarterly reminder to enterprise customers
